name: cavemio-avatar-cropper
title: Avatar cropper
description: The profile photo field without a modal: the avatar itself grows into the crop, and shrinks back with the face you framed.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The avatar is a button: Enter or Space opens the file picker, and paste takes a photo from the clipboard while focus is anywhere in the field. Dropping a file on the avatar or the stage opens it.
- The stage is focusable: arrow keys move the photo (Shift for bigger steps), plus and minus zoom, R rotates, Enter saves and Escape cancels. The zoom slider is a native range input; the zoom is announced when it settles, never while it moves.
- One frame loop with fixed 4ms steps writes transforms to three nested layers (move, zoom, turn) and sleeps once everything is still; React only hears about it then. The layers are promoted while they move and released after, so the photo is redrawn sharp at its new size.
- Only the stage takes touch (touch-action: none); the page itself is never locked. Wheel and trackpad pinch zoom about the pointer and don't scroll the page while over the photo.
- The crop is drawn from the original at full resolution with the same transform you see, so what lands in the circle is what you saved.
- Reduced motion opens and closes in place and the photo goes straight to its bounds instead of springing.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: name
props.description: – · Whose photo: the initials when there's none, and the accessible names.

props.name: onSave
props.description: – · Receives the cropped square and { centerX, centerY, size, rotation } in the original's pixels. Resolve with the stored URL (or nothing to show the crop itself); throw to show the error.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · After a save lands or a removal.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: – · Shows Remove while there's a photo.

props.name: shape
props.description: "circle" · "square" crops a rounded square, for workspace and team logos.

props.name: outputSize
props.description: 512 · Side of the saved square in px.

props.name: outputType
props.description: "image/webp" · Any type canvas.toBlob encodes, with outputQuality (0.9).

props.name: maxSize
props.description: 10_000_000 · Largest file in bytes; bigger ones are refused with a shake and the limit.

props.name: maxZoom
props.description: 4 · How far past the fit it zooms.

props.name: hint
props.description: – · Under the title; it gives way to how to crop while editing.

props.name: ref
props.description: – · open(file | blob | url) and browse(), e.g. for a photo from your own picker or a camera.

features.title: Choose, drop or paste
features.description: Click the avatar, drop a file on it or paste from the clipboard. A file over maxSize is refused with the limit.

features.title: Crop like a photo you hold
features.description: Drag, pinch or scroll to zoom up to 4x, and rotate in quarter turns. The crop never shows a gap.

features.title: Works from the keyboard
features.description: Arrow keys move the photo, plus and minus zoom, R rotates, Enter saves and Escape cancels.

features.title: Saves a ready-made square
features.description: onSave gets a 512px WebP by default, plus where the crop sits in the original photo.

features.title: Saving has states
features.description: Save becomes Saving, then Saved. A failure shakes the button, says Try again and keeps the stage open.

features.title: Circle or square
features.description: Use a circle for people and a rounded square for workspace and team logos.

states.title: idle
states.description: The avatar with Upload or Replace, and Remove when there's a photo. Hovering dims it and shows a camera; dragging a file over it scales it to 1.06 with a slight overshoot and thickens its ring.

states.title: open
states.description: The avatar's circle grows into a stage up to 320px in 560ms: it starts as exactly the avatar (the crop circle scaled onto it) and widens its clip to the stage's rounded square while the space below eases open. The dim and the controls fade in 160–220ms later.

states.title: hold
states.description: Dragging moves the photo one to one; past an edge it gives less the further it goes (iOS's 0.55 resistance) and the thirds appear inside the crop. Pinch and scroll zoom about the fingers or pointer, from the fit to 4x.

states.title: release
states.description: The photo carries its release speed and slows down; anything outside the bounds springs back critically damped, keeping that speed. The zoom then rolls to its new percent.

states.title: rotate
states.description: A quarter turn clockwise in 560ms with a slight overshoot; the photo springs inside the new bounds while it turns.

states.title: save
states.description: Save → Saving → Saved (StatusButton), then the stage shrinks back into the avatar's circle with the crop in it. The new photo is decoded before it lands, so the hand-over is invisible. A failed save shakes the button and reads Try again; the stage stays.

states.title: cancel
states.description: Escape or Cancel shrinks the stage back and fades it over the last 45% while the old photo (or the initials) fades back in.

states.title: remove
states.description: Remove → Removing, then the photo dissolves into the initials through a blur.
